info.title: The Go brain socket
info.description: Described from Go's side: "receive" methods are sent by the Server, "send" methods are sent by Go. Frames are JSON-RPC 2.0.

send_event.name: send_event
send_event.title: send_event
send_event.summary: Something changed in a trip. One event per change, in change-number order for each trip.

card_tap.name: card_tap
card_tap.title: card_tap
card_tap.summary: Someone tapped a button on one of Go's cards. Go answers what the App should do.

catch_up.name: catch_up
catch_up.title: catch_up
catch_up.summary: Someone came back to the room after a while. Go answers what they missed.

get_person.name: get_person
get_person.title: get_person
get_person.summary: What Go knows about a person, with where each fact came from.

update_person.name: update_person
update_person.title: update_person
update_person.summary: Turn carry-over on or off for a person.

delete_fact.name: delete_fact
delete_fact.title: delete_fact
delete_fact.summary: Remove one thing Go knows about a person.

forget_person.name: forget_person
forget_person.title: forget_person
forget_person.summary: Forget me: in one trip, or everywhere.

vault_link.name: vault_link
vault_link.title: vault_link

place_info.name: place_info
place_info.title: place_info

get_option_details.name: get_option_details
get_option_details.title: get_option_details

read_trip.name: read_trip
read_trip.title: read_trip

read_messages.name: read_messages

replace_card.name: replace_card

update_trip.name: update_trip

add_vote_options.summary: 1.3: add options to an open vote, for the options "See more" brought. At most 20 in all; votes cast stay.

set_mandate.name: set_mandate
set_mandate.title: set_mandate
set_mandate.summary: Set what the group allowed for a closed choice vote: the choice, the cap, refundable only, and who pays.

add_record_line.name: add_record_line
add_record_line.title: add_record_line
add_record_line.summary: Add an agreed, open or doing line to the trip record.

update_record_line.name: update_record_line
update_record_line.title: update_record_line
update_record_line.summary: Change a line Go wrote, or mark it done.

add_expense.name: add_expense
add_expense.title: add_expense

Category.description: The spending category. The App colours: stay blue, food orange, getting around green, activities yellow.

Actor.description: Who did it: a person, Go, or the Server itself (system).

VoteCard.description: A vote. The Server draws the options, the tally and the vote buttons.

MandateCard.description: Ready to book: what the group allowed (the choice, the cap, refundable or not, who pays). The Server shows "Yes, book it" and "Not now" to the payer only.

TicketCard.description: A booking, drawn as a ticket (boarding pass, stay pass, table).

ExpenseCard.description: One expense: who paid, how much, split between whom.

SettleUpCard.description: Who pays whom right now, each with a UPI button.

PlanCard.description: The whole itinerary, day by day.

BudgetCard.description: Spent against the plan, by category.

OptionsCard.description: Options Go found (stays, flights, places...), with prices and when they were checked.

RoomsCard.description: 10 Oct B5: after a stay is picked, the ways the group can take its rooms and who shares with whom. A tap is card_tap with option_id = the arrangement's id.

WorkingCard.description: Go doing a longer job (booking on a website, comparing many options). Updated in place.

CallCard.description: Go on a phone call to a business. Updated in place while it runs; the final version is the record.

PayCard.description: A payment waiting for the payer. Their "Approve" button opens the vault page, where they confirm with Face ID.

NoticeCard.description: Good to know (with its source) or a heads-up (a deadline, a price change, a clash).

ChecklistCard.description: 1.1: a checklist for the group, one row a person, each todo, started, done or info. Updated in place.

PostMessage.description: Needs text, a card, or both.

MessageCreated.description: Someone posted in the room (Go's own messages come back too).

MessageEdited.description: Someone edited a message. Carries the message as it is now.

MessageDeleted.description: Someone deleted a message. Go drops anything it learned from it.

ReactionAdded.description: Someone reacted to a message. A thumbs up can count as agreeing.

PersonJoined.description: Someone joined the trip, with their join answers (never their budget answer).

PersonUpdated.description: Someone changed their details, or paused or unpaused Go.

TripCreated.description: A new trip room. Carries the whole trip, so Go can greet the group and start.

TripUpdated.description: Trip details changed. Read the trip to see the new values.

DecisionVoted.description: Someone voted, changed their vote, said they are flexible (1.1), or took their vote back (1.1).

DecisionClosed.description: A vote closed, with the result.

DecisionOptionsAdded.description: 1.3 (rev 5 R5): options were added to an open vote ("see more", add_vote_options). Their indexes continue from the last option; votes already cast stay.

MandateSet.description: Go set what the group allowed for a spend.

MandateConfirmed.description: The payer tapped "Yes, book it". Go may now ask for a spend approval.

RecordChanged.description: A trip record line was added, changed, finished or undone.

BookingChanged.description: A booking was added, changed or cancelled.

ExpenseChanged.description: An expense was added, removed, or (1.1) changed.

SettlementRecorded.description: 1.1: someone recorded paying someone back. It counts at once, so its status is always confirmed.

ReadMessages.description: Up to 200 at a time; 200 when limit is left out. The Server sends fewer, with has_more: true, when the answer would go over the 1 MB frame limit.

OpenDecision.description: Opens a vote. Go then posts a message with a vote card to show it in the room.

AddVoteOptions.description: 1.3: adds options to an open vote, for the options a "See more" tap brought.

SetMandate.description: Sets (or replaces) what the group allowed for a closed choice vote. Replacing clears the payer's earlier yes or no.

UpdateRecordLine.description: Only the fields sent change. Go cannot undo a line; only people can.

CatchUp.description: For one person only. Shown above the room, never posted in it.

SocketRequest.description: A request. The other side answers it once, with a result or an error, using the same id.

SocketNotification.description: A notification: no id, no answer. Used only for Go's typing.

SocketResult.description: The answer to a request that worked.

SocketError.description: The answer to a request that did not work.

SpendApprovalClaims.description: What the Server signs. exp is at most 600 seconds after iat. A group approval carries decision_id; 1.2's ticket approval carries for_person_id (and kind "ticket") instead, and its payer is that person.
